privacyModal.title: Privacy and Data Use
privacyModal.intro: GUIAA is committed to protecting your privacy and that of your pets. By using this platform:
items: Consultation data is stored securely and encrypted
Only you can access your pets’ or patients’ information, depending on your account type
We do not share information with third parties without your consent, except necessary service providers or legal requirements
We comply with applicable data-protection rules in Latin America
You may request deletion of your data at any time

privacyPolicy.title: Data protection and privacy
privacyPolicy.frameworkIntro: Where applicable, the Platform complies with:
frameworkItems: Mexican Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP)
Equivalent personal-data protection principles in other Latin American countries where the service is offered
General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) when applicable
privacyPolicy.collectedIntro: Depending on account type, we may collect:
collectedItems: MVZ: professional identity (name, country, license, institution), contact, and clinical Platform use
Client / owner: name, email, phone (optional), pet data, reported symptoms, and guidance history
Payment data needed for memberships (MVZ) or B2C consults (Client)
Technical usage data for security and operations
Anonymized or aggregated data to improve the service
useItems: Provide and improve the service (clinical CDS or informational clinical guidance)
Verify professional credentials (MVZ only) and authenticate accounts
Process payments and applicable tax obligations
Support, security, fraud prevention, and legal compliance
securityItems: Encryption of data in transit and access controls
Separation of MVZ and Client layers (histories and quotas are not mixed)
Certified payment providers receive only what is needed to charge
We do not sell personal data
privacyPolicy.contact: To exercise your ARCO rights or privacy inquiries, email
